question: The element 'x' in the modern periodic table has an electronic configuration 2, 8, 8. The element 'x' is placed in the ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**18th group**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Given that the given element has an **electronic configuration of 2,8,8**, which means that its** valency is completely full **and is a **noble or inert element,** its **outermost orbit is complete.**
 
• The element having electronic configurations **2, 8, 8 possesses a complete octet**. It is therefore a** noble gas**. Along with the other **noble gases**, it will be **located in group 18.**
 
• The** valence shell orbitals** of the elements in** Group 18** are entirely** filled**. As a result, they only **react with a few substance**s under specific circumstances. As a result, they **are referred to as noble gases.**
 
• *Therefore, the element 'x' is placed in the 18th** group*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to the **octet rule**, atoms are most **stable when eight electrons **are present **in each valence shell.**
 
• It is based on the observation that the** atoms** of the main group elements tend to form **chemical bonds** that result in each atom** having eight electrons** in the valence shell of the **subsequent molecule. **Only the** principal group elements** are covered by the **law of the octet.**
 
• It is thought that the **halogens, oxygen, nitrogen, and carbon** molecules adhere to the **octet laws. **The **s-block and p-block **elements are frequently those that adhere to this law.
